relationships.subject: microglia
relationships.evidence_quote: Microglia activated by ischemic stroke can secrete TNF, adipocyte fatty acid-binding protein (A-FABP) and metalloproteinase 9 (MMP-9) to trigger endothelial necroptosis and BBB leakage

relationships.subject: TREM2
relationships.evidence_quote: in murine AD models, microglial TREM2 can bind with C1q to rescue synaptic loss

key_findings: Review of microglial ontogeny, subtypes/states, functions and roles in neuropsychiatric disorders.
